title: City Council Meeting
motion: A motion was made by Alison Stroud, seconded by Scott Earl, to adopt Ordinance 22-18 amending the effective date of the ordinance to be March 1, 2023, or upon the adoption of an ordinance that creates a large animal hobby license, whichever comes first. The Council further directs the Administration to prepare for council consideration, no later than February 1, 2023, an ordinance that amends Chapter 12-2 of the Animal Services Code to create a large animal hobby license for residential properties, throughout Sandy City, where more than 4 large animals are kept
